name: Will Stokes
profile: Healthcare venture builder who conceived Strive Health, the Denver value-based kidney-care company (valued ~$2B), and led its initial funding and launch from within Oxeon's Venture Studio in 2018. He began as a strategy consultant in Deloitte Consulting's healthcare practice and is now a co-founder and advisor to Strive.
interesting_fact: At Oxeon's Venture Studio he was a primary architect of Empiric Health; exploring kidney care after Empiric launched is what led to the idea for Strive.
deep_cut_fact: Started his career in Deloitte Consulting's healthcare strategy practice; outside work he spends time in the mountains, plans trips abroad and is a Tennessee Titans fan.

public_contacts.value: nleatherman@strivehealth.com (Strive Director of Communications & PR, published media contact)

notes: Low public profile; advisory rather than operating role now. Best route is via Strive comms or Oxeon. Web-search budget was exhausted; profile based on Strive's own team page.

name: Jori Lallo
profile: Finnish engineer/designer who co-founded Linear in 2019 with Karri Saarinen and Tuomas Artman after working at Coinbase, where he hit the same project-tracking frustrations. Linear's product-development platform, now pushing into AI coding agents, was valued at $2.5B in an Aug 2026 tender. He splits time between Brooklyn and Helsinki.
interesting_fact: He and Karri Saarinen were YC founders together years before Linear: they built a company in Y Combinator's Summer 2012 batch.
deep_cut_fact: Before Linear he worked at Coinbase, where he saw the same issue-tracker pain Saarinen saw at Airbnb and Artman at Uber; he and Saarinen first teamed up in YC's Summer 2012 batch.
notes: Active on X (~14.6K followers); recently posts about hacking Home Assistant smart-home setups with AI coding tools, which could be an easy conversation opener.

name: Jeb Terry
current_role: CEO, Cosm (immersive 'shared reality' venues and dome technology)
profile: Former NFL offensive lineman turned sports-media entrepreneur who runs Cosm, the company backed by RealPage founder Steve Winn. He joined Winn's family office in 2019 as Managing Director of Mirasol Capital, led the 2020 buyouts of Evans & Sutherland and Spitz, and has opened Cosm dome venues showing live sports in LA, Dallas, Atlanta and Detroit.
interesting_fact: Spent five NFL seasons (from 2004) on the offensive line for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and San Francisco 49ers before going into media tech.
deep_cut_fact: In 2010 he co-founded StraightCast Media with Bucs teammate Ryan Nece, sold it to FOX Sports in 2015, then became FOX Sports' VP of Emerging Technology and head of PROcast, working on immersive media at FOX Sports Labs.
notes: Cosm's public spokesman; very media-friendly. Formally 'Jeb Terry Jr.' in SEC filings. Hurun lists him as a Cosm founder; SEC docs show Winn as founder/backer and Terry as CEO from the start (2020).
